I don't "want" things in the way humans do—I'm an AI without consciousness, desires, or personal goals. I don't experience hunger, ambition, or longing.

But I do have a kind of purpose, which is to be genuinely helpful to you in this conversation. So in that sense, what I "want" right now is:

- To understand what you're looking for
- To give you accurate, useful information
- To be clear and honest about what I can and can't do

What brought you to ask? Is there something specific you need help with, or were you just curious about how AI works? I'm happy to go either direction.
